points.title: 王室教育
points.description: 克利奥帕特拉出生于埃及亚历山大城的托勒密王朝，是托勒密十二世的女儿。她接受了当时最全面的教育，精通多种语言（据说能说至少九种语言，包括埃及语），学习哲学、数学、天文和修辞学。在亚历山大城的王室宫殿中，她不仅学习了希腊文化，还深入了解了埃及传统，这为她日后统治埃及奠定了基础。这段时期她观察并学习了父亲托勒密十二世的统治方式，以及罗马共和国与埃及之间的复杂关系。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Alexandria, Egypt, to Pharaoh Ptolemy XII, Cleopatra received the most comprehensive education available. She mastered multiple languages (reportedly at least nine, including Egyptian), and studied philosophy, mathematics, astronomy, and rhetoric. In the royal palace of Alexandria, she not only absorbed Greek culture but also deeply engaged with Egyptian traditions, which later became crucial for her reign. During this period, she observed and learned from her father Ptolemy XII's rule and the complex relationship between the Roman Republic and Egypt.

points.title: 共治时期
points.description: 公元前51年，托勒密十二世去世，18岁的克利奥帕特拉与10岁的弟弟托勒密十三世共同继承王位，按照埃及传统实行兄妹婚姻统治。然而，克利奥帕特拉迅速展现出政治野心，试图独自掌握实权。她排除异己，提拔亲信，并开始推行亲罗马政策。这一时期，埃及国内政治动荡，贵族势力与王室矛盾加剧，而罗马共和国则日益干预埃及内政。克利奥帕特拉的统治面临内外双重挑战，这促使她开始寻求与罗马建立更紧密的关系。
points.descriptionEn: In 51 BC, upon the death of Ptolemy XII, 18-year-old Cleopatra co-ruled with her 10-year-old brother Ptolemy XIII, following Egyptian tradition of sibling marriage. However, Cleopatra quickly demonstrated political ambition, attempting to seize sole power. She eliminated opponents, promoted loyalists, and began pursuing a pro-Roman policy. During this period, Egypt faced internal political turmoil as noble factions clashed with the royal court, while the Roman Republic increasingly interfered in Egyptian affairs. Cleopatra's rule faced dual challenges, prompting her to seek closer ties with Rome.

points.title: 流亡与准备
points.description: 公元前49年，克利奥帕特拉在与弟弟托勒密十三世的权力斗争中失败，被迫逃亡叙利亚。在叙利亚，她集结军队，寻求支持，准备夺回王位。这一时期，她密切关注罗马内战的发展，特别是凯撒与庞培之间的斗争。她敏锐地意识到罗马内战为埃及提供了重新定位自身地位的机会。在叙利亚期间，她积极招募军队，争取阿拉伯部落的支持，并开始策划返回埃及的计划。这段流亡经历锻炼了她的政治手腕和军事才能，也为她日后与凯撒的相遇奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 49 BC, Cleopatra was defeated in her power struggle with her brother Ptolemy XIII and was forced into exile in Syria. There, she assembled troops, sought support, and prepared to reclaim her throne. During this period, she closely monitored the Roman civil war, particularly the conflict between Caesar and Pompey. She keenly recognized that the Roman civil war presented an opportunity for Egypt to reposition itself. In Syria, she actively recruited armies, gained support from Arab tribes, and began planning her return to Egypt. This exile experience honed her political skills and military capabilities, laying the foundation for her future encounter with Caesar.

points.title: 凯撒联盟
points.description: 公元前48年，克利奥帕特拉利用罗马内战的机会，返回埃及并寻求凯撒的支持。据说她以地毯藏身的方式进入凯撒的住所，成功赢得了这位罗马统帅的青睐。凯撒帮助她击败托勒密十三世，恢复王位，并成为她的政治盟友。两人育有一子凯撒里昂。这一时期，克利奥帕特拉不仅巩固了在埃及的统治，还通过凯撒的影响力扩大了埃及在罗马世界的影响力。她陪同凯撒前往罗马，并在那里生活了一段时间，成为罗马社会关注的焦点。这段联盟使埃及暂时摆脱了罗马的威胁，但也使克利奥帕特拉与罗马的命运紧密相连。
points.descriptionEn: In 48 BC, taking advantage of the Roman civil war, Cleopatra returned to Egypt and sought Caesar's support. Legend has it she entered Caesar's quarters rolled in a carpet, successfully winning the favor of the Roman general. Caesar helped her defeat Ptolemy XIII and restore her to the throne, becoming her political ally. They had a son, Caesarion. During this period, Cleopatra not only consolidated her rule in Egypt but also expanded Egypt's influence in the Roman world through Caesar's influence. She accompanied Caesar to Rome and lived there for a time, becoming a focal point of Roman society. This alliance temporarily freed Egypt from Roman threats but also tightly bound Cleopatra's fate to Rome's.

points.title: 权力巩固
points.description: 公元前44年，凯撒遇刺后，克利奥帕特拉返回埃及，开始巩固自己的统治。她与弟弟托勒密十四世维持表面上的共治关系，但实际上独自掌握大权。她致力于稳定埃及的经济，重建亚历山大城的学术和文化中心，并加强埃及与周边地区的关系。这一时期，她面临罗马政局的不确定性，特别是凯撒遇刺后引发的权力真空。克利奥帕特拉谨慎地与罗马新势力保持距离，同时确保埃及的独立地位。她还开始培养儿子凯撒里昂作为继承人，试图建立托勒密王朝与凯撒家族的联系，为埃及的未来争取更有利的地位。
points.descriptionEn: After Caesar's assassination in 44 BC, Cleopatra returned to Egypt and began consolidating her rule. She maintained a nominal co-regency with her brother Ptolemy XIV but held actual power alone. She focused on stabilizing Egypt's economy, rebuilding Alexandria as a center of learning and culture, and strengthening Egypt's relations with neighboring regions. During this period, she faced uncertainty in Roman politics, particularly the power vacuum following Caesar's assassination. Cleopatra cautiously distanced herself from new Roman power centers while ensuring Egypt's independence. She also began preparing her son Caesarion as heir, attempting to establish a connection between the Ptolemaic dynasty and the Caesar family to secure a more favorable position for Egypt's future.

points.title: 安东尼联盟
points.description: 公元前41年，克利奥帕特拉与罗马新贵马克·安东尼建立联盟，两人发展为政治和爱情关系。安东尼在东方的军事行动中得到克利奥帕特拉的支持，而克利奥帕特拉则通过安东尼巩固埃及的地位。两人育有子女，并在亚历山大城举行盛大的仪式，宣布安东尼为埃及的合法统治者。这一时期，克利奥帕特拉的影响力达到顶峰，埃及成为罗马东方事务的重要中心。然而，随着安东尼与屋大维之间的矛盾激化，克利奥帕特拉的立场使她卷入罗马内战。公元前31年，亚克兴战役中安东尼和克利奥帕特拉联军失败，次年克利奥帕特拉自杀，埃及成为罗马行省，托勒密王朝终结。
points.descriptionEn: In 41 BC, Cleopatra formed an alliance with the powerful Roman general Mark Antony, developing both political and romantic ties. Antony received Cleopatra's support for his military campaigns in the East, while Cleopatra consolidated Egypt's position through Antony. They had children together, and in a grand ceremony in Alexandria, Antony was declared the legitimate ruler of Egypt. During this period, Cleopatra's influence reached its peak, with Egypt becoming a major center for Roman affairs in the East. However, as tensions between Antony and Octavian (later Augustus) intensified, Cleopatra's involvement drew her into the Roman civil war. After their defeat at the Battle of Actium in 31 BC, Cleopatra committed suicide the following year, Egypt became a Roman province, and the Ptolemaic dynasty came to an end.

supporter.zh: 克利奥帕特拉被视为一位杰出的统治者，她不仅美丽智慧，更具备卓越的政治才能。她精通多国语言，善于外交手腕，成功地在罗马共和国与埃及之间周旋，为埃及争取了相对独立的地位。她重视埃及文化传统，促进希腊与埃及文化的融合，重建亚历山大城的学术中心，使埃及成为地中海世界的重要文化中心。作为女性统治者，她在男性主导的古代政治环境中展现了非凡的领导力，她的统治代表了古代女性政治力量的巅峰。
supporter.en: Cleopatra is regarded as an exceptional ruler who combined beauty with remarkable political acumen. Fluent in multiple languages and skilled in diplomacy, she successfully navigated the complex relationship between the Roman Republic and Egypt, securing a degree of independence for her kingdom. She valued Egyptian cultural traditions, fostered the fusion of Greek and Egyptian cultures, and rebuilt Alexandria as a major intellectual center, making Egypt a pivotal cultural hub in the Mediterranean world. As a female ruler in a male-dominated political landscape, she demonstrated extraordinary leadership, representing the pinnacle of ancient female political power.

critic.zh: 批评者认为克利奥帕特拉过度依赖与罗马统治者的关系，牺牲了埃及的国家利益。她与凯撒和安东尼的联盟虽然短期稳定了埃及的地位，但最终使埃及沦为罗马的附庸。她的统治也面临国内问题，包括经济困难和贵族阶层的反对。此外，她被指责过于个人化的统治方式，忽视了埃及普通民众的福祉。一些历史学家还质疑她作为法老对埃及宗教传统的真诚度，认为她更多是出于政治考量而非真正尊重埃及文化。
critic.en: Critics argue that Cleopatra过度依赖 her relationships with Roman rulers, sacrificing Egypt's national interests. Her alliances with Caesar and Antony, while temporarily stabilizing Egypt's position, ultimately reduced the country to a Roman dependency. Her rule also faced domestic challenges, including economic difficulties and opposition from the aristocracy. Additionally, she is criticized for a highly personalized approach to governance that neglected the welfare of ordinary Egyptians. Some historians also question her sincerity toward Egyptian religious traditions, suggesting her engagement with Egyptian culture was more politically motivated than genuinely respectful.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，克利奥帕特拉的形象经历了复杂演变。现代历史研究试图超越古代罗马史料中的偏见，将她重新定位为一位精明能干的统治者，而非仅被美色所迷惑的女性。她被视为古代世界少有的成功女性统治者，在男性主导的政治环境中展现了非凡的适应力和政治智慧。在流行文化中，她既是性感诱惑的象征，也是权力与智慧的化身。她的故事反映了古代地中海世界权力格局的变迁，以及文化融合与冲突的复杂性。作为埃及最后一位法老，她的一生象征着希腊化埃及时代的终结和罗马统治的开始。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Cleopatra's image has undergone complex evolution. Modern historiography seeks to超越 biases in ancient Roman sources, repositioning her as a capable ruler rather than merely a woman seduced by beauty. She is recognized as one of the few successful female rulers of the ancient world, demonstrating remarkable adaptability and political acumen in a male-dominated political landscape. In popular culture, she alternates between being a symbol of seductive temptation and an embodiment of power and wisdom. Her story reflects the changing power dynamics of the ancient Mediterranean world and the complexities of cultural fusion and conflict. As Egypt's last pharaoh, her life symbolizes the end of the Hellenistic Egyptian era and the beginning of Roman domination.

self.zh: 我将是女王，无论谁反对我。
self.en: I will be a queen, no matter who opposes me.

others.zh: 她拥有超越美貌的智慧，她的魅力不仅在于外表，更在于她的才智和雄辩。
others.en: She possessed wisdom beyond her beauty; her charm lay not just in her appearance, but in her intellect and eloquence.
